Subject: Assurance appendix and pen test window (HealthBridge)

Hi Mina,

Thanks for the demo last week — team is keen to move forward contingent on two items in the contract: the assurance appendix and the inspection/pen test language. Attached is a short spreadsheet that tracks the items we need gated from our InfoSec team (column: ask / priority / evidence type). High level asks: a) SOC 2 report sharing cadence and redaction policy, b) a 30–45 day pen-test notice window and staging access parameters, and c) confirmation of evidence delivery cadence (what you can provide and when).

We'd like to lock a tentative pen-test window in Q4; our security ops suggested Oct 4–8 as a target. Can you confirm Redwood's typical approach to:
- SOC 2: how recent is the report you can share, and can you provide a read-only copy to our security reviewers?
- Pen test: does Redwood accept a limited-scope external test against staging? What guardrails do you require?
- Evidence cadence: do you provide an evidence handoff (artifact list + sampling) and a technical owner for questions?

I've attached the spreadsheet (HealthBridge_Assurance_Request.xlsx) and our standard questionnaire. If useful, we can do a 30-minute call with our security leads next week.

Thanks,
Priya Sinha
Sr. Procurement Manager | HealthBridge

Hi Priya — thanks for the clear list and the spreadsheet. We can support the items you listed; I’m looping in our legal and security leads to propose redlines and operational constraints. Quick answers up front:
- SOC 2: we can share the most recent SOC 2 Type II report (2025) under an NDA/read-only viewer. Redaction policy: we remove customer-identifying data and internal HR salary tables; we'll note specifics in the addendum.
- Pen test: we accept a third-party limited-scope test against a staging environment. Typical constraints: scheduled 48–72 hour notice for elevated access changes, a single coordination contact, and non-production rate limits.
- Evidence cadence: we'll provide an artifact manifest and a named technical contact for follow-ups; for sampling we typically provide up to 30 days of logs for the scoped systems.

Next steps: Karthik/Marissa/Olga — can you review Priya's spreadsheet and suggest: 1) redline language for the assurance appendix, 2) an acceptable pen-test notice window and staging access bullet points, and 3) a draft evidence cadence (deliverables + timing)? I propose we consolidate into a single Assurance_Addendum_MR-v1.docx and return to HealthBridge by EOD Tuesday (18 Aug).

Priya — will that turnaround work for you? If so, we’ll also include a proposed mutual action plan and a suggested timing for Oct 4–8 if that still looks feasible.

Best,
Mina Haddad

Subject: Re: INTERNAL: healthbridge assurance asks — proposed redlines

Mina / team — quick summary of proposed contract language and constraints. I put the suggested redline doc in the attachments (Assurance_Addendum_KIR-proposed.docx). Highlights:

1) SOC 2 sharing
- Language: "Supplier will provide Customer with a read-only copy of the most recent SOC 2 Type II report upon execution of NDA; Supplier may redact Customer-identifying information and internal HR/compensation schedules. Requests for additional artifacts will be evaluated and provided under a scoped NDA and mutually agreeable timetable."
- Rationale: balances transparency with internal confidentiality.

2) Pen test / inspection rights
- Language: "Customer may conduct a single third-party penetration test against Supplier's non-production (staging) environment per 12-month period, subject to Supplier's staging access rules, a written test plan submitted at least 21 days in advance, and mutually agreed test scope. Supplier will provide a named operational contact and agreed rate limits; Supplier reserves the right to pause or terminate test activity if production impact is observed."
- Optional concession: reduce notice period to 14 days for customers in an enterprise amendment where additional coordination is acceptable.

3) Evidence cadence and delivery
- Language: "Supplier will deliver an assurance artifact manifest within 5 business days of request and will provide requested sampled artifacts within 10 business days, subject to redaction and regulatory restrictions. Supplier will assign a technical owner for the evidence window and will respond to clarifying questions within 48 business hours."

Open items for negotiation: pen-test frequency (customer asked quarterly; we must keep annual or one per 12 months), and the notice window (we propose 21 days standard; security may accept 14 as an escalated concession).

I've attached the redline and a short playbook excerpt. Marissa / Olga — can you confirm operational feasibility on the proposed timelines (21 / 14 days) and the artifact sampling/retention constraints so I can finalize language?

Attachment: Assurance_Addendum_KIR-proposed.docx (redline)

What Redwood can commit to now:
- SOC 2: we will provide the read-only SOC 2 Type II (2025) report under an NDA. Redactions: customer PII and internal compensation tables will be removed; additional artifacts can be provided under scoped NDA.
- Pen test: staging-only, one external test per 12 months. Standard notice: 21 days with a proposed concession to 14 days if HealthBridge signs the enterprise amendment (see addendum). Santa Clara staging access requires a named technical contact and agreed rate limits; Supplier can pause tests that affect production.
- Evidence cadence: we will deliver an artifact manifest within 5 business days of request and sampled artifacts within 10 business days. A technical owner will be assigned for the window and will respond to clarifying questions within 48 business hours.

Proposed timeline / next steps (mutual action plan):
1) HealthBridge to review the attached addendum and indicate any non-starters by EOD Thu (20 Aug).
2) If agreed, both sides sign the addendum and execute the NDA (we can initiate DocuSign).
3) Target pen-test window: Oct 4–8, 2026 (tentative). Once NDA/Addendum signed, HealthBridge provides a test plan no later than Sep 13, 2026 (21 days prior).
4) Redwood will circulate the artifact manifest and SOC 2 read-only access link within 5 business days of NDA execution.
